book.name: Amaki̠
book.title: Ib̠eb̠i Asu̠gbagba Ma̠ Agu̠o̠ Amaki̠ Age̠ Bho̠

content: A̠zizo̠s a̠wa̠ ma̠ ta̠ ob̠ogion otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠
Igiel bho̠ A̠zizo̠s na̠ a̠mite d̠a̠ Otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠, sa̠ odi o̠ni̠ atu̠ghan d̠o̠yo̠ a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ i̠na ma̠a̠, “Kpone! A̠libhon ikputu bho̠ na̠ a̠rutu bho̠!”

content.text: “Inyin na̠ o̠bi̠gh ibom a̠rutu i̠nye̠n? Bebina̠ ikputu ola̠ ta̠ a̠sughonom i̠se̠n ola̠ odi ta̠ aro̠ d̠a̠ anyu̠ ta̠ odi bo̠, ola̠ ko ob̠ogion d̠o̠ bo̠.”

content: A̠zizo̠s aro̠ ma̠ a̠dila̠de d̠a̠ anyu̠ Igu Oliv d̠a̠ esumogha̠n Otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠, sa̠ A̠puta̠, na̠ A̠zemsi, na̠ Azo̠n, na̠ Anduru, iru ra̠ ipura̠n i̠na d̠a̠ e̠wo̠gi̠na ma̠a̠,
“O̠ni̠ atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠, gba ma̠ a̠nigha̠ i̠yar, i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n ka̠ ta̠ emite ma̠ a̠kere obhel? Sa̠ i̠yar ta̠ obhin a̠kere a̠d̠ien elegh ologhom ma̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n na̠ etua̠n omite?”
Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s agba a̠nigha̠ awa ma̠a̠,

content.text: “I̠mare̠ ma̠ ekpona̠ ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ o̠ni̠ ko ogelemeni d̠o̠ inyin.
A̠d̠izo a̠nwunom ta̠ ebhin a̠d̠ien d̠ami̠ eru ra̠ e̠gba ma̠a̠, ‘Ami̠ i̠na!’ sa̠ awa ta̠ egelemeni ma̠ a̠d̠izo ogbo.
Ya̠a̠, o̠ni̠ ko okperenuma̠ ma̠ igiel inyin u̠mu̠gho̠n oghur re̠gham na̠ i̠mu̠mu̠gho̠n re̠gham. O̠kpo̠ ya̠ o̠ku̠a ta̠ emite, ya̠a̠ o̠ku̠a na̠ oma̠ra̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ na̠ ate̠i̠ ekunuguma̠ bho̠.

Ebhugh ta̠ a̠wia̠n ebhugh, sa̠ a̠de e̠ma ta̠ a̠wia̠n a̠de e̠ma. Ra̠de ta̠ eb̠ob̠omia̠n kesi kesi, sa̠ o̠ko̠i̠ ed̠ia̠n ta̠ a̠sor. Ya̠a̠, i̠nye̠n ta̠ e̠ro̠ ma̠ o̠pu̠r o̠ke̠ ali̠gam a̠ruzu ma̠ agu̠o̠ iguna̠ i̠mara.

“Be̠le̠ni̠, i̠mare̠ ma̠ ekpona̠. Ta̠ ob̠ologh inyin obhin o̠gi̠ d̠a̠ a̠rutu osobh ase̠ d̠a̠ re̠ma bho̠ na̠ d̠a̠ a̠rutu u̠gala A̠zu, sa̠ ta̠ o̠gu̠ro̠gh inyin. Sa̠ ta̠ o̠marame̠ni̠ inyin d̠a̠ a̠misigh ogbo aru̠mu̠ ebhugh na̠ aru̠lala e̠ma d̠a̠ ebula̠ ami̠, ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ inyin ta̠ o̠gba ami̠ onigha̠ awa.
Ta̠ od̠ia̠ o̠gba nyen ib̠eb̠i asu̠gbagba bho̠ omutiom onigha̠ ma̠ eb̠la̠ ra̠dede.

Sa̠ igiel ubhin inyin u̠gi̠o̠m awa, o̠ni̠ ko od̠ia̠ ma̠ e̠ku̠nu̠ ma̠ agu̠o̠ obhin o̠gba o̠nu̠. Kpe̠le̠me̠ni̠, i̠gba ma̠ i̠di̠ar iya̠ unigha̠ inyin d̠a̠ ogbo obhel bha̠. Ezin bho̠, inyin d̠o̠ ma̠ ogbo ya̠ ta̠ e̠gba bho̠, ya̠a̠ E̠mu̠gh E̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠.
“Umor ta̠ a̠wol umor ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ ogigh, sa̠ o̠we̠de̠ ta̠ a̠wol o̠nyi̠, sa̠ anwi̠i̠ny ta̠ ewia̠n ronweni na̠ ro̠we̠de̠ ma̠ o̠ze̠gi̠ awa.
Sa̠ ko̠ni̠ ko̠ni̠ ta̠ asu̠a inyin d̠a̠ ebula̠ a̠d̠ien d̠ami̠. Ya̠a̠, o̠ni̠ wa̠ a̠ne tu̠tu̠n ka̠ a̠kunugiom bho̠, bha̠ oten.

“Igiel inyin u̠bi̠gh ‘ka̠ ibom i̠pi̠o̠gho̠m wa̠ na̠ api̠e̠gi̠ ma̠ i̠di̠ar bho̠’ na̠ amara ma̠ esi bho̠ osora̠n d̠o̠ i̠na ma̠ o̠ro̠ bho̠, (bha̠ o̠ni̠ wa̠ na̠ a̠sen bho̠ amu̠gho̠nyan), o̠ni̠ wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ A̠zudia̠ bho̠ a̠kpo ma̠ eghil ad̠u̠a agi̠ d̠a̠ ebhugh rigu bho̠.
O̠ni̠ ola̠ od̠i d̠a̠ anyu̠ otu osor d̠o̠ a̠ru ra̠ a̠bhin abar d̠a̠ otu d̠o̠yo̠ a̠mite.
O̠ni̠ ola̠ od̠i d̠a̠ o̠si̠ omula̠ d̠o̠ agi̠ ka̠ a̠bhin akapa anyu̠ d̠o̠yo̠.
Ekulom anwani̠ a̠rughun na̠ iya̠ anwi̠i̠ny od̠id̠ia̠ na̠ e̠mam d̠a̠ ra̠d̠a̠ma̠ i̠ye̠.
Ya̠a̠, isiseinye ma̠ o̠kpo̠ i̠nye̠n omite d̠o̠ ma̠ obhel a̠d̠igho.
Ezin bho̠, a̠d̠ien egbika̠ ra̠d̠a̠ma̠ i̠ye̠ ta̠ omite d̠o̠ ka̠ d̠a̠ o̠pu̠r ob̠eton o̠le̠me̠gh i̠di̠ar ya̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ale̠m bho̠ tu̠tu̠n ra̠ ate̠i̠ i̠se̠n, sa̠ ka̠ omula̠ mu emite.

“Sa̠ ku̠gba ma̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ na̠ okperemeni d̠o̠ ma̠ obhel bho̠, bha̠ o̠ni̠ ola̠ ta̠ a̠miza̠n bo̠. O̠ku̠a eka̠, d̠a̠ ebula̠ ogbo ya̠ i̠na na̠ aso̠n a̠bhin bho̠, bha̠ i̠na na̠ a̠kperemeni ma̠ obhel bho̠.
Sa̠ d̠a̠ obhel obha̠, ka̠ o̠ni̠ a̠ru ra̠ agba ma̠a̠, ‘Ikpone! Akrai̠st od̠i ma̠ i̠se̠n!’ bo̠d̠o̠, ‘Ikpone! I̠na od̠i ma̠ ebha̠,’ o̠ni̠ ko oma̠ra̠.
Rakrai̠st igunugha̠ na̠ a̠riwil igunugha̠ ta̠ emite eru ra̠ egir ilologia̠n, sa̠ ta̠ emutioghom relegh ya̠ obhin ogelemeni a̠nwunom, ku̠gba ma̠ a̠b̠ur, bha̠ ogbo iya̠ na̠ o̠so̠n bho̠ nyen.
Ikpona̠ o! Ami̠ nà̠ agba kabar kabar a̠nigha̠ inyin i̠se̠n kisa̠ obhel bho̠ ta̠ a̠lei.
“D̠a̠ ra̠d̠a̠ma̠ i̠ye̠, ma̠ igiel ali̠gam a̠ruzu bho̠ na̠ eten,
“ ‘sa̠ ogogo bho̠ ta̠ azu̠,
sa̠ uwetire bho̠ ko o̠mu̠ mu̠;
sa̠ i̠ni̠nai̠ny bho̠ ta̠ e̠d̠u̠a d̠a̠ e̠nai̠ny emeleghu,
sa̠ ra̠limon e̠nai̠ny ta̠ enyegia̠n.’
“Sa̠ d̠a̠ obhel obha̠, a̠nwunom ta̠ o̠bi̠gh ka̠ O̠nyi̠ ta̠ O̠ni̠ na̠ a̠bhin d̠a̠ o̠b̠u̠ghu̠b̠u̠gh bho̠ na̠ a̠ru na̠ ibom a̠limon na̠ isosorogia̠n.

Sa̠ i̠na ta̠ a̠ruom itileduom d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ o̠gi̠ ka̠ okokod̠i ogbo ya̠ i̠na na̠ aso̠n bho̠, d̠a̠ inya̠ re̠ku̠l e̠mara̠nwunom bho̠, ob̠eton d̠a̠ ekunuguma̠ o̠gbaki̠ a̠de ka̠ o̠te̠i̠ d̠a̠ ekunuguma̠ obhubhulom.
“I̠se̠n, ibhine ma̠ a̠sidogh oriren a̠fig
bho̠ ma̠ e̠tu̠ghan abar. Igiel i̠gha d̠o̠yo̠ na̠ edugh sa̠ i̠mu̠nu̠mu̠n bho̠ na̠ e̠mu̠r na̠ emite, bha̠ inyin na̠ ologhom ma̠ a̠kozogh na̠ a̠tua̠n.
Onin agu̠o̠ bho̠, igiel inyin u̠bi̠gh ka̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n na̠ emite, bha̠ iloghome ma̠a̠, na̠ a̠tua̠n, na̠ a̠misi d̠a̠ o̠nu̠otu.
Ya̠gia̠ga̠i, ami̠ na̠ agba na̠ a̠nigha̠ inyin ma̠a̠, amu̠m onon ko oten d̠o̠ kisa̠ eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n ta̠ emite.
A̠de na̠ e̠nai̠ny ta̠ eten e̠d̠u̠a, ya̠a̠ ikpo a̠fugh d̠ami̠ ko oten d̠o̠ na̠ oten e̠d̠u̠a.

content: O̠ni̠ ola̠ a̠loghom a̠d̠a̠ma̠ na̠ obhel bho̠ bo̠

content.text: “I̠se̠n, iya̠ igboloma̠ ma̠ a̠d̠a̠ma̠ bo̠d̠o̠ obhel bho̠, bebina̠ o̠ni̠ ola̠ a̠loghom bo̠, a̠d̠igh itileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ d̠a̠ ote̠nai̠ny, O̠nyi̠ bho̠ eka̠, a̠sigimeni ma̠ O̠we̠de̠ bho̠.
Ikpona̠! Igone! Ezin bho̠ inyin uloghom d̠o̠ ma̠ obhel bho̠ ekunuguma̠ obhel bho̠ ta̠ aro̠.
Agu̠o̠ o̠ni̠ ola̠ a̠b̠etina̠ ma̠ e̠gi̠, sa̠ awe̠le̠man eghun otu d̠o̠yo̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ igoni d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ okponom, o̠ni̠no̠ o̠ni̠no̠ ma̠ abar ola̠ ta̠ a̠gir, sa̠ a̠ruom okponomotu
bho̠ ma̠a̠, aro̠ ma̠ omom a̠gon.

“O̠ku̠a a̠d̠ighi be̠le̠ni̠, igone, ezin bho̠ inyin uloghom d̠o̠ ma̠ obhel bho̠ wa̠nwuna̠ ma̠ otu bho̠ ta̠ a̠mula̠ a̠ru. Ta̠ a̠rue aro̠ ma̠ a̠dule, bo̠d̠o̠ egum a̠d̠io, bo̠d̠o̠ d̠a̠ obhel olobhiri e̠nu̠r na̠ alal, bo̠d̠o̠ ame̠ghe̠le̠.
Ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ ka̠ a̠ru ma̠ awai̠, i̠na o̠bi̠gh d̠o̠ ma̠ anwa na̠ a̠kod̠u.
Sa̠ abar wa̠ ami̠ na̠ agba na̠ a̠nigha̠ inyin bho̠, bha̠ ami̠ na̠ agba na̠ a̠nigha̠ ko̠ni̠ ko̠ni̠. ‘Igone!’ ”

footnotes.text: A̠fig: Odi ad̠ien oriren d̠a̠ ebhugh Izre̠l, ola̠ na̠ a̠guna̠ ma̠ a̠d̠igho, sa̠ i̠mu̠n na̠ ra̠lele d̠o̠yo̠ na̠ e̠mu̠r na̠ emite ma̠ igiel a̠kozogh na̠ a̠ru.
Okponomotu: O̠ni̠ ipoiny ola̠ na̠ aro̠ d̠a̠ o̠nu̠otu na̠ a̠gon.
